item: NBC News projects Democratic Sen. Jon Ossoff wins re-election in Georgia over Republican Rep. Mike Collins, with about 25% of the expected vote counted.
Polls closed in North Carolina and Ohio. Fox News reported North Carolina's statewide results are delayed about 45 minutes after some polling sites stayed open late.
Decision Desk HQ projects Democratic Sen. Jon Ossoff wins re-election in Georgia, minutes after polls closed. AP had not called the race at the time.
Polls closed in Georgia, Virginia, South Carolina, Vermont and most of Florida.
First mainland polls closed in parts of Indiana and Kentucky.
Guam: Democrat Alicia Limtiaco won the congressional delegate seat over the Republican incumbent by about 2 points, per unofficial results. Republican Tony Ada won Guam's governor race.
South Carolina set a record for total votes cast in a governor's election (Democrat Jermaine Johnson vs. Republican Alan Wilson).
